# GUI Interface Description: GIMP Image Manipulation Program

## System and Application Header

- **Operating System Environment**: Activities (Linux desktop environment indicator)
- **Application Title Bar**: GNU Image Manipulation Program
- **Date and Time Display**: Oct 23 16:27
- **Window Control Buttons**: Minimize, Maximize, Close (top-right corner)
- **Application Status Bar**: 
  - Image file name: `[ID_specimen] (imported)-1.0`
  - Image properties: `(RGB color 8-bit gamma integer, GIMP built-in sRGB, 1 layer) 1280x960`
  - Application identifier: `– GIMP`

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items** (from left to right):
  - File
  - Edit
  - Select
  - View
  - Image
  - Layer
  - Colors
  - Tools
  - Filters
  - Windows
  - Help

## File Menu Dropdown

- **File Menu is Open** (indicated by mouse cursor hovering over "File")
- **Menu Items**:
  - New...
  - Create
  - Open...
  - Open as Layers...
  - Open Location...
  - Open Recent
  - Save...
  - Save As...
  - Save a Copy...
  - Revert
  - Overwrite ID_specimen.jpg
  - Export As...
  - Create Template...
  - Print...
  - Send by Email...
  - Copy Image Location
  - Show in File Manager
  - Close View
  - Close All
  - Quit

## Desktop Environment Sidebar

- **Application Icons** (left vertical dock):
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP (active application icon)
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help (question mark icon)
  - Trash

## Image Canvas

- **Image Content**: French National Identity Card specimen
  - Text: "RÉPUBLIQUE FRANÇAISE", "CARTE NATIONALE D'IDENTITÉ / IDENTITY CARD"
  - Name: "MARTIN", "Maëlis-Gaëlle, Marie"
  - Sex: "F", Nationality: "FRA"
  - Date of Birth: "13 07 1990"
  - Place of Birth: "PARIS"
  - Document Number: "D2H6862M2"
  - Expiry Date: "11 02 2030"
  - Signature field with number "546497"
  - "SPÉCIMEN" watermark
  - French flag and EU flag logos
  - Background with watermark text
  - Portrait of a woman
- **Canvas Border**: Yellow dashed rectangle indicating active selection or canvas boundary
- **Image Scale**: 66.7%

## Toolbars and Panels

### Left Panel: View and Highlight Settings

- **Highlight Settings**:
  - Toggle: "Highlight" (enabled)
  - "Highlight opacity": 50.0
  - "No guides" dropdown
  - "Auto Shrink" button
  - "Shrink merged" checkbox (unchecked)

### Top Toolbar (Hidden)

- **Image Dimensions**: 1280x960
- **Image File Size**: 11.5 MB
- **Zoom Level**: 66.7%
- **Units**: px
- **Navigation Controls**: Zoom in/out, reset view, rotate, etc.

### Right Panel: Tool Options

#### Tool Presets

- **Brush Tool Presets**:
  - "Basic" preset selected
  - "Spacing": 10.0
  - Brush shapes: various brush tips, star, circle, square, etc.

#### Layer Panel

- **Layer Properties**:
  - Mode: Normal
  - Opacity: 100.0%
  - Lock: Lock icon (locked)
  - Layer Name: "ID_specimen"
  - Layer thumbnail: image preview

#### Tool Options Panel

- **Tool Settings**:
  - "Hardness 050 (51 x 51)" brush selected
  - Tool options: brush size, hardness, spacing, etc.

## Status Bar

- **Image File Name**: ID_specimen.jpg (11.5 MB)
- **Zoom Level**: 66.7%
- **Units**: px
- **Navigation Controls**: Zoom in/out, reset view, rotate, etc.

## Window Management

- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close (top-right corner)
- **Window Title**: GNU Image Manipulation
